newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia PM Howard in hospital with pneumonia.
newsitem.headline: Australia PM Howard in hospital with pneumonia.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard was admitted to hospital on Friday, suffering from pneumonia, his office said.
Howard's office said Treasurer Peter Costello had been appointed acting prime minister until Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer returned from holidays on Sunday night when he would take over.
"On doctor's advice and to enable a full recovery from his current illness, the Prime Minister, Mr John Howard, has been admitted to hospital in Sydney," his office said in a statement.
"He is likely to be in hospital for the best part of next week."
Earlier this week, Howard, who will be 58 on Saturday, was suffering from bronchitis and influenza, but was diagnosed as having pneumonia late on Friday.
The prime minister's illness prevented him from attending a government cabinet meeting on Tuesday and would prevent him from meeting New Zealand Prime Minister Jim Bolger this weekend.
Howard would also be unable to attend the next cabinet meeting, to be held in Perth on Tuesday, his office said.
